boundary.description: From the junction of Ripponden Road and Ship Lane, along Saddleworth Civil Parish boundary to Greenacres Road. Then W by Greenacres Road, Esther Street, Clarksfield Road, Brewerton Road, Roundthorn Road and by a bee-line to the River Medlock near, and including Coverham Avenue and Ferndale Close. S by River Medlock to Abbey Hills Road, Lees New Road to, but excluding Cockfields Farm. Then W by a beeline to and N along Snipe Clough and King’s Road to the point opposite Belgrave Road. By a bee-line to and NW by Belgrave Road and Scottfield road, and by a bee-line to Park Road, excluing Eldon Street and Brookfield Street estate. E by Park Road, then NE by Woodstock Street, Waterloo Street and NE by a footpath s of Oldham Way to the junction of Oldham Way and Lees Road, and N by the Railway to the point opposite Sumner Streer, and E to the Saddleworth Civil Parish boundary and Lower Dingle. E along Lower Dingle to Ripponden Road and its junction with Ship Lane.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between Sacred Heart with Our Lady and St Anne with St Michael
internalBoundaries.description: From the S border of Lower Strinesdale Reservoir. Then W by a bee-line to Furze Lane (all of Armdale Rise estate in St Anne and St Michael parish). SW along Furze Lane, NW border of Waterhead Park and then S by Sharples Hall Street and by a beeline to and along Leamington Street, Vincent Avenue, Little Moor Lane, Shrewsbury Avenue, Vulcan Street, Prince Charlie Street, Derker Street, Arnold Street to the Railway.
